description: Return a Marketcaper stock heatmap summary with reported observation and update times, plus a hosted dark-theme PNG image URL. Supports US or global universes, classic or bubble views, optional sector/category filtering, and capped summary rows. Hosted images share a 10 images/day/IP limit. This is not a bulk feed extraction tool.

category.description: Optional sector/category name or slug, such as "Financial Services" or "communication-services". When supplied, the image includes only that category.

metric.description: Optional heatmap sizing metric: "marketCap", "volume", or "turnover". Defaults to "marketCap".

response_format.description: Optional output format. Use "json" when a client needs machine-parseable text blocks, especially for Claude artifacts.

timeframe.description: Optional performance timeframe: "1H", "4H", "1D", "1W", "1M", or "1Y". Defaults to "1D".

universe.description: Optional stock universe. Use "us" for US top stocks or "global" for global top stocks. Defaults to "us".

view.description: Required heatmap image view. Use "classic" for the sector tile map or "bubble" for the bubble stock heatmap.

name: get_stock_heatmap
title: Get stock heatmap
